name: Model Router
description: Routes OpenClaw subagent spawns to your small or large model and an effort that fits the task, judged by Jev. For each routed sessions_spawn call it sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, and the agent's description, cut to 500 characters, both with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, and the spawn's one-line label as written, unmasked, to api.typesafe.ai, openrouter.ai or both, as its provider setting allows, each with its own key. The spawn of the requesting agent itself sends that agent's description when it has one and a fixed text when it has none. The plugin sets a model only from your small_model and large_model settings, and only after OpenClaw resolves it and holds a credential for it. The scope setting picks the spawns: core routes the spawn of the requesting agent itself; extended also routes the spawns of other agents that set no model. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process OpenClaw starts.

provider.label: Jev provider
provider.help: Which providers judge each task, in order. auto: TypeSafe, then OpenRouter. openrouter-first: OpenRouter, then TypeSafe.

scope.label: Routing scope
scope.help: Which spawns are routed. core: the spawn of the requesting agent itself. extended: also the spawns of other agents that set no model.

small_model.label: Small model
small_model.help: The model a spawn gets when Jev rates its task small, written as provider/model. Unset: such a spawn keeps the model OpenClaw would give it.

large_model.label: Large model
large_model.help: The model a spawn gets when Jev rates its task large, written as provider/model. Unset: such a spawn keeps the model OpenClaw would give it.

api_key.label: TypeSafe API key
api_key.help: Your TypeSafe API key. The plugin sends it to TypeSafe only, as the bearer token of the scoring request, and only when the provider setting allows TypeSafe. Unset: the plugin reads TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment.

openrouter_api_key.label: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.help: Your OpenRouter API key. The plugin sends it to OpenRouter only, as the bearer token of the scoring request, and only when the provider setting allows OpenRouter. Unset: the plugin reads OPENROUTER_API_KEY from the environment.
